escenas.texto: This week in Africa, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over two hundred and sixty million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Africa edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Africa. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. In position number ten, from Kenya, Bahati Kenya, with a video posted five days ago. Over three point one million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over eight thousand comments.

Number nine, Sonia Uche Tv, with a video posted six days ago. Over five point eight million views. A video over one hundred and thirty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four thousand comments.

Number eight, Itelediconstudio, with a video posted five days ago. Over six point nine million views. A video over ninety-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over seven thousand comments.

Next up, number seven, Silly AI Lab, with “Por favor comparte con tus amigos”. Over seven million views. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.

In position number six, from Nigeria, Agbaps Shorts, with “Spies Escaping A Laser At Every IQ Level”. Over eight million views. A Short of just thirty seconds. It also has one hundred and thirty-four comments.

Coming in at number five, mc3🐾🐞, with “please don't come for me”. Over thirteen million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and forty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

At number four, Grinch Menace, with “Comment Christmas if you want one TODAY!”. Over fourteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about seven thousand, one hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eleven seconds.

Bronze medal, SportFiction , with “Mbappé Yamal Exposed Haaland’s Fake Injury Instantly”. Over fourteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-three seconds.
Silver medal, from Egypt, Omar kotb, with a video posted three days ago. Over eighteen million views. A Short of just nineteen seconds. It also has over eighty-seven thousand likes.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, Goodluck Amarachi Yusuf, with “Our new pediatrician taught me this”. Over thirty-one million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eighteen seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Coming in at number ten, from Libya, Colomby, with a video posted five days ago. Seven hundred and forty-one comments. It also has over eighty-eight thousand views.

In position number nine, FoltynGaming, with “Stealing millionaire supercars in gta 6!”. Seven hundred and eighty-eight comments. A video over twenty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.

In position number eight, DLT, with a video posted one day ago. Eight hundred and fifty-two comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over seventy-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
At number seven, from Egypt, سيف - SAYKO, with a video posted four days ago. Nine hundred and eighty-two comments. It also has over three hundred and seventeen thousand views.

Coming in at number six, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd, with a video posted six days ago. Over one thousand comments. A video over twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one point two million views.

In position number five, from Morocco, la3zawi family Two, with a video posted four days ago. Over one thousand comments. A video over thirty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one point four million views.
Number four, from Morocco, SHAW, with a video posted four days ago. Over one thousand comments. It also has over seven hundred and twenty-five thousand views.

Bronze medal, Sonia Uche Tv, with a video posted six days ago. Over four thousand comments. A video over one hundred and thirty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five point eight million views.

Silver medal, Itelediconstudio, with a video posted five days ago. Over seven thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about fifty-seven thousand views per hour. A video over ninety-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
And here it is. Number one most commented, from Kenya, Bahati Kenya, with a video posted five days ago. Over eight thousand comments. It also has over three point one million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Coming in at number ten, Grinch Menace, with “Comment Christmas if you want one TODAY!”. Over thirty-eight thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about seven thousand, one hundred subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eleven seconds.

Next up, number nine, Sonia Uche Tv, with a video posted six days ago. Over fifty-one thousand likes. A video over one hundred and thirty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five point eight million views.

Next up, number eight, from Nigeria, Agbaps Shorts, with “Spies Escaping A Laser At Every IQ Level”. Over fifty-three thousand likes. A Short of just thirty seconds. It also has over eight million views.

At number seven, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd, with a video posted six days ago. Over fifty-seven thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Number six, mc3🐾🐞, with “please don't come for me”. Over fifty-eight thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and forty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Bronze medal, Itelediconstudio, with a video posted five days ago. Over ninety-three thousand likes. A video over ninety-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over six point nine million views.

Silver medal, Goodluck Amarachi Yusuf, with “Our new pediatrician taught me this”. Over one hundred and four thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about thirteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eighteen seconds.
And finally, number one most liked, from Kenya, Bahati Kenya, with a video posted five days ago. Over one hundred and twenty thousand likes. It also has over three point one million views.
